purpose: A per-example audit view that combines one immutable, uncorrupted tokenizer-bound logical-motif record with a reproducible epoch-keyed mask decision. A collator emits a separate corrupted CE batch item. It replaces neither the historical geometry sidecar schema nor the v3 release manifest. The mainline profile is CE-first; C3 state prediction is a separately declared conditional profile.

invariants: all arrays have length L
identity and connection tokens map to exactly one logical motif
boundary and text tokens map to -1
the record is unpadded and every attention_mask value is true
every identity span is a nonempty half-open token interval and spans are pairwise disjoint
every identity token is covered exactly once by its motif identity span
each motif has one unique carrier equal to the first token of its identity span
connection_token_indices partition all connection-role tokens by motif
motif_atom_indices are nonempty, pairwise disjoint, and cover every atom exactly once
each motif slot ordinal maps to exactly one atom through motif_slot_atom_indices
each cross-motif edge has two canonically ordered endpoints in distinct motifs and each endpoint atom equals motif_slot_atom_indices[motif][slot]
edge IDs and edge records are canonical and densely ordered from zero
slot_count equals both motif_slot_atom_indices length and endpoint-incidence count for each motif
atom_to_logical_motif is exactly the inverse membership declared by motif_atom_indices
model_to_source_atom_index is strictly increasing with every value in [0,source_atom_count)
full_e3fp_ids has shape [A,K] with values in [-1,4095]
P1 geometry is deliberately narrow: every atom_valid_mask value is true and every E3FP row has a non-padding level-0 identifier
every motif_geometry_valid value is true; partial geometry requires a later schema version
atom_is_attachment is true exactly for atoms referenced by cross_motif_bonds

identity_recovery_mask.semantics: Select complete logical-motif identity spans for standard T5 sentinel corruption and conditional identity recovery. Canonical connection tokens and E3FP state remain available for this view.

state_prediction_mask.semantics: Select geometry-valid motifs whose student E3FP input is cleared while identity and connection remain visible. It is disjoint from identity_recovery_mask.

invariants: target_logical_motif_indices are the strictly increasing true indices of state_prediction_mask
target_vectors has shape [number_of_targets,target_dim] and contains finite unit-L2 vectors
teacher targets are runtime artifacts and must not be persisted as immutable dataset features

global_invariants: identity_recovery_mask is present and selects at least one logical motif in every training record
identity_recovery_mask is reproduced from mask_decision using SHA-256 scores keyed by seed, epoch, member_id, objective, and logical motif index
state_prediction_mask and c3_teacher are forbidden in ce_first
state_prediction_mask and c3_teacher are required in c3_ema_state_prediction
state_prediction_mask may select only geometry-valid motifs
no token position, string equality, DFS order, or compacted atom offset may be used to infer a cross-domain mapping
identity digests and connection token surfaces still require a separately hash-locked production codec round-trip gate
this audit view contains no identity_sentinel role, corrupted input, decoder label, or padding; those belong to a separate collated-batch contract
this record cannot authorize P1; admission is a separately resolved p1_admission_decision artifact
